[30th November, 1935.]
An Act to amend
the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, in its application to the *[Province of Sind].
1.Short title and extent.--(I)
This Act may be called the **[Sind] Criminal
Procedure an (Elections Offences) Amendment Act, 1935.
(2) It shall apply to the whole
of the, *[Province of Sind].

3. Amendment of Schedule II to
Act V of 1898.--In Schedule II to the same Code-
(a) in the entry
relating to section 17IF of the ***[Pakistan]
Penal Code, the words "and personation" shall be deleted, XLV of
1860;
(b) after the
said entry so amended, the following shall be inserted, namely:
Personation at an election. May
arrest without warrant.
Ditto.
Ditto.
Ditto.
Ditto.
Ditto.
(c) in the third
column in the entry relating to section 171G of the *[Pakistan]
Penal Code, for the word "Ditto", the words "Shall not
arrest without warrant" shall be substituted, XLV of 1860.
